specs.name: lengthOfLIS_empty
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_empty : ∀ (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond []), lengthOfLIS [] h_precond = 0

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_singleton
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_singleton : ∀ (x : Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond [x]), lengthOfLIS [x] h_precond = 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_le_length
specs.stmt: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), lengthOfLIS nums h_precond ≤ nums.length

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_nonneg
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_nonneg : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), 0 ≤ lengthOfLIS nums h_precond

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_pos_of_nonempty
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_pos_of_nonempty : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), nums ≠ [] → 0 < lengthOfLIS nums h_precond

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_result_is_subseq_len
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.contains (lengthOfLIS nums h_precond)

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_is_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.all (· ≤ lengthOfLIS nums h_precond)

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_append_ge
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_append_ge : ∀ (nums : List Int) (x : Int) (h1 : lengthOfLIS_precond nums) (h2 : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums ++ [x])), lengthOfLIS nums h1 ≤ lengthOfLIS (nums ++ [x]) h2

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_prefix_le
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_prefix_le : ∀ (l1 l2 : List Int) (h1 : lengthOfLIS_precond l1) (h2 : lengthOfLIS_precond (l1 ++ l2)), lengthOfLIS l1 h1 ≤ lengthOfLIS (l1 ++ l2) h2

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_sorted_eq_length
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_sorted_eq_length : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), List.Pairwise (· < ·) nums → lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_constant_eq_one
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_constant_eq_one : ∀ (x : Int) (n : Nat) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond (List.replicate (n + 1) x)), lengthOfLIS (List.replicate (n + 1) x) h_precond = 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_ge_one_of_nonempty
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_ge_one_of_nonempty : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), nums.length ≥ 1 → lengthOfLIS nums h_precond ≥ 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_meets_postcond
specs.stmt: ∀ args (h : lengthOfLIS_precond args), lengthOfLIS_postcond args (lengthOfLIS args h) h

specs.name: maxInArray_ge_zero
specs.stmt: ∀ (arr : Array Nat), maxInArray arr ≥ 0

specs.name: maxInArray_mem_or_zero
specs.stmt: theorem maxInArray_mem_or_zero : ∀ (arr : Array Nat), arr.size = 0 ∨ maxInArray arr ∈ arr.toList

specs.name: maxInArray_is_upper_bound
specs.stmt: theorem maxInArray_is_upper_bound : ∀ (arr : Array Nat) (i : Fin arr.size), arr[i] ≤ maxInArray arr

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    lengthOfLIS nums h ≥ 0

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_nonempty_pos
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_nonempty_pos : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), nums.isEmpty = false → lengthOfLIS nums h ≥ 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_empty
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_empty : ∀ (h : lengthOfLIS_precond []), lengthOfLIS [] h = 0

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_le_length
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_le_length : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), lengthOfLIS nums h ≤ nums.length

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_eq_max_dp
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    nums.isEmpty = false →
    ∃ (dp : Array Nat), dp.size = nums.length ∧
      dp.size > 0 ∧
      lengthOfLIS nums h = maxInArray dp ∧
      maxInArray dp ∈ dp.toList

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_empty
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_empty : lengthOfLIS [] trivial = 0

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_nonempty
specs.stmt: lengthOfLIS nums h ≥ 1
